key: consumers generally have up to 30 minutes after they pay for the transfer to cancel the transaction, as long as the money has not been picked up by the recipient or has not been deposited into the recipient’s account. if a remittance transfer is scheduled more than three business days in advance, it can be canceled if the provider receives the cancellation request up to three business days before the scheduled date of the transfer.
english: Consumers generally have up to 30 minutes after they pay for the transfer to cancel the transaction, as long as the money has not been picked up by the recipient or has not been deposited into the recipient’s account. If a remittance transfer is scheduled more than three business days in advance, it can be canceled if the provider receives the cancellation request up to three business days before the scheduled date of the transfer.
korean: 수취인이 돈을 찾아가지 않았거나 수취 계좌에 입금되지 않았다면, 소비자는 일반적으로 송금대금을 지급한 후 30분 이내에 거래를 취소할 수 있습니다. 영업일 기준 3일보다 앞서 예약한 송금은 예정 송금일로부터 영업일 기준 3일 전까지 송금업자가 취소 요청을 받으면 취소할 수 있습니다.

key: consumers see information including the amount of money to be transferred, the exchange rate, fees charged by the provider, taxes collected by the provider, and the amount of money expected to be delivered abroad (not including taxes or fees that may be collected on the receiving side). the company might have to provide the information in the language it used in its marketing materials or when it conducted the transaction, as well as in english.
english: Consumers see information including the amount of money to be transferred, the exchange rate, fees charged by the provider, taxes collected by the provider, and the amount of money expected to be delivered abroad (not including taxes or fees that may be collected on the receiving side). The company might have to provide the information in the language it used in its marketing materials or when it conducted the transaction, as well as in English.
